mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0
